# WebsitesPixel

Shopify design and development studio. Founded 2026.
The team has built 150+ Shopify stores since 2020, previously under another name.
Based in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh, India. Clients are primarily United States based.
Contact: hello@websitespixel.com | https://websitespixel.com/contact/
Hours: 7am-1pm ET weekdays, reply within one working day.

## What we do
Shopify store design, development, migration, conversion optimisation,
speed, SEO, email and retention, automation and ongoing maintenance.
Builds are fixed-price, agreed in writing before they start; ongoing work
runs on the monthly Shopify Growth plan. One named person the client
messages directly.

All services: https://websitespixel.com/services/

## Pricing
Shopify Launch - $1,499, one-time project fee, 4-6 weeks. First real store. 30 days post-launch support.
Shopify Rebuild - $1,999, one-time project fee, 6-8 weeks. Existing store that underperforms. 30 days post-launch support.
Shopify Growth - $699/month, monthly subscription. Up to 15 hours of agreed work a month across development, store management, SEO, marketing support, CRO and analytics. Cancel any month.
Full detail: https://websitespixel.com/pricing/
Shopify Growth plan detail: https://websitespixel.com/growth-subscription/

## Free store teardown
Send a store URL and receive a written review within three working days
of what is costing sales, ranked by impact. No call required, no cost.
https://websitespixel.com/free-audit/
